Camera blocked by Google Sites

Google Sites embeds can deny camera permission even when your phone allows it. Open the navigation app directly in its own HTTPS tab, not inside the Google Sites frame.

Publish the HTML at a standalone HTTPS address and add a button on Google Sites linking to that address. QR scanning cannot be guaranteed inside an embed.

🔒 Teacher Admin — QR codes

Enter teacher passcode to open QR printing and testing tools.

Only selected learning locations have missions. Students choose Easy or Hard and receive a random question or activity. Other QR codes update location without a mission. The question banks are built into this HTML and shared across devices.
